page_note: Page is a systematic enumeration of the nine thrones of the Light-aeons and the (nine) thrones placed in this cosmos. Pure cosmological-substrate teaching: ordinal markers (second/third/.../ninth) + cosmic figures (Mother of Life, First Man, Beloved of the Lights, Great Builder, Living Spirit, Third Ambassador, Jesus the Radiance, Great Mind) + cosmic geography (ship of day, ship, aeons, Zone). The brief doxological close (seg 31) and the gathering of 'churches' to the Great Mind (seg 27) are within the cosmic-eschatological frame here. The ecclesial-vocab flag at seg 27 reads 'churches gather to the Great Mind' as cosmic ingathering, not institutional polity — substrate. Page is overwhelmingly substrate; the editorial-fatigue flag is mostly an artifact of a single ecclesial term in late segments.
